title: Trump urges Republicans to vote for release of Epstein files in surprise U-turn
summary: US president says he backs efforts to release documents related to late sex offender because ‘we have nothing to hide’ US politics live – latest updates How the Epstein row plunged Maga world into turmoil – a timeline Epstein emails: key takeaways from 20,000 pages of newly released files Donald Trump has told his fellow Republicans in Congress to vote for the release of files related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, in a sudden reversal of his earlier position.
